blocks.construct: mean thermal regime and temperature seasonality
annual precipitation amount and precipitation seasonality
surface shortwave energy and atmospheric drying power
precipitation accumulated during the climatic growing season

incremental_tests.purpose: test whether the predeclared process variables explain 18D capitulum structure not already represented by the frozen four BIO predictors
incremental_tests.method: nested multivariate R2 with Freedman-Lane permutation of reduced-model response residual rows; within-taxon residual rows are permuted only within taxon, among-taxon residual rows across taxa

omnibus.multiplicity: single predeclared omnibus test per scope and biological scale; not included in block-specific BH family

incremental_tests.block_specific_multiplicity: BH across the four block-specific extension tests separately within each replication scope and biological scale

selection_rule: No substitution with alternative variables after trait outcomes are inspected; unavailable blocks remain unavailable.
claim_boundary: Blocks are process contexts, not measured causal mechanisms at the capitulum. A supported incremental test means the extension contains spatial information beyond the frozen four predictors for this observational 18D estimand; it does not identify a causal process.
